name: Padua’s fourteenth-century fresco cycles
description: Eight churches, chapels and civic buildings inside Padua's old city walls hold some of Europe's most influential wall paintings, all made between 1302 and 1397. Giotto's Scrovegni Chapel, with its deep blue vault and lifelike, emotional figures, is the star. Other masters' cycles show patrons painted into the stories and scenes with a new sense of depth, anticipating the Renaissance.
